sources.title: Artificial Intelligence in Modern Deep-Learning QSAR
sources.snippet: General workflow of AI-Driven QSAR modeling: Data collection → preprocessing → feature extraction → model building → validation → prediction.

sources.title: Machine Learning- and AI-Driven QSAR Models for the Discovery of Novel ...
sources.snippet: To accelerate the identification of fungicides targeting acid phosphatase inhibition (FAPI), machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven quantitative structure–activity relationship (QSAR) models incorporating topological molecular descriptors have been employed to predict fungicidal activity.
